title: Coffland
creator: CrossFit
description: Hang from a pull-up bar for a total of 6 minutes; every time you drop, run 800 m and do 30 push-ups before getting back on. Honours U.S. Army Spc. Christopher J. Coffland, killed by an IED in Wardak Province, Afghanistan, in 2009. Grip is the whole workout; chalk up.
